name: Ferienwohnung Lisa
beschreibung: The Holiday Apartment Lisa is located in the quiet municipality of Ebbs in Tirol, directly at the foot of the imposing Kaisergebirge. The surroundings are characterized by a close-to-nature and tranquil atmosphere. Guests can expect a fully equipped, modern apartment that offers all amenities for an independent holiday. Nearby are numerous hiking and cycling trails that invite you to go exploring. In winter, the ski areas of the Kitzbüheler Alpen are quickly reachable. The town of Kufstein with its fortress and cultural offerings is also easy to visit. Thus, the Holiday Apartment Lisa is ideally suited as a starting point for active and relaxing days in the Tiroler Alpen.
